name: Custom Theme
description: Netflix-style skin for Jellyfin: rotating hero carousel, genre rows, top nav tabs, native hover previews, settings panel and 15 fonts. Self-contained on most installs (no Media Bar / Home Sections / Custom Tabs needed); on read-only / Docker web roots, install the File Transformation plugin so the header button loads.
overview: Netflix-style skin: hero carousel, genre rows, nav tabs, settings panel, 15 fonts. On read-only/Docker installs the File Transformation plugin is recommended.
